# Positive Thots

> Education-first relationship wellness app for ethical non-monogamy, polyamory, and LGBTQ+ communities. Users complete badge courses before unlocking matchmaking.

Positive Thots ("Think Positive Thots.™") is built around the principle "Learn first. Connect better." The platform combines a structured relationship-education curriculum with a consent-forward matching experience.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the app and education-gated matching.
- [Learn](/learn): Badge-based curriculum covering consent, communication, and relationship structures.
- [Premium](/premium): Subscription plans and Thot Pack credit bundles.
- [Resources](/resources): Curated books, tools, and community resources.
- [Events](/events): Community events and ticketing.
- [Health & Testing](/health-testing): STI testing information and resources.
- [Testing Locator](/testing-locations): Find nearby STI testing locations.
- [Community Guidelines](/community-guidelines): Conduct rules and enforcement tiers.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach support, billing, safety, and legal.
